phase9.title: Timeblock Phase 9
phase9.nav.label: Phase 9 navigation
phase9.safe.internal_fgo: Internal FGO is a governed internal balance and benefit planning layer inside Timeblock. It is not cash, an investment asset, cryptocurrency, and cannot be withdrawn.
phase9.safe.points: Internal points are only used inside Timeblock. They have no cash value, are not transferable, and cannot be withdrawn.
phase9.treasury.title: Treasury overview
phase9.treasury.heading: Treasury dashboard
phase9.treasury.intro: Monitor system pool, participant pool, treasury health, conversion review queue, and Phase 9 go-live readiness.
phase9.treasury.snapshot_body: Each rebuild creates an incremental version and calculation hash for later reconstruction and comparison.
phase9.treasury.allocate_member_fgo_body: This creates a member Internal FGO wallet and writes both member wallet and treasury ledger records. Internal FGO remains a Timeblock governed internal balance, not an on-chain asset.
phase9.treasury.allocate_business_fgo_bo: This increases the business Internal FGO balance and writes both business wallet and treasury ledger records. Businesses cannot bypass the Timeblock service layer to mutate balances.
phase9.governance.title: FGO governance
phase9.governance.heading: Internal FGO governance center
phase9.governance.intro: Manage conversion rate, treasury thresholds, per-request limits, and governance action records.
phase9.governance.freeze_note: When the treasury state is frozen, the system does not allow approval of new conversion requests.
phase9.risk.title: Conversion risk review
phase9.risk.heading: Conversion risk review
phase9.risk.intro: Generate a risk score from requested points, pending request frequency, and treasury health to help admins decide whether to approve.
phase9.recovery.title: Reserve recovery
phase9.recovery.heading: Reserve recovery recommendations
phase9.recovery.intro: The system creates governance recommendations from treasury health. This flow does not connect to on-chain assets and does not represent cash or investment behavior.
phase9.recovery.action_log_body: Triggered actions are written to treasury ledger and governance action records for admin tracking.
phase9.conversion_queue.title: Conversion review queue
phase9.conversion_queue.heading: Conversion request queue
phase9.conversion_queue.intro: Manage the review and execution flow for business internal points to Internal FGO requests.
phase9.verify.title: Ledger verification
phase9.verify.heading: Ledger chain verification results
phase9.verify.intro: The system checks content hash, previous hash, and block hash for each record.
phase9.policy_simulator.title: Policy simulation
phase9.policy_simulator.heading: Policy simulation center
phase9.policy_simulator.intro: Test conversion rate, treasury thresholds, and per-request limits before deciding whether to submit a governance policy change request.
phase9.policy_simulator.note: Policy simulations only write to the governance ledger and do not directly change the active policy.
phase9.policy_requests.title: Policy change requests
phase9.policy_requests.heading: Policy change requests
phase9.policy_requests.intro: Formal governance policy changes must be submitted and approved before they can apply to treasury and conversion rules.
phase9.policy_requests.note: Creating a request does not apply it immediately. Governance review must be completed first.
phase9.business_wallet.title: Business wallet
phase9.business_wallet.heading: Business points and activity ledger
phase9.business_wallet.intro: View business internal points, Internal FGO governed balance, conversion eligibility, and activity attribution summary.
phase9.business_wallet.eligibility_body: Eligibility is calculated live from policy, per-request limits, risk state, and treasury state. It is not stored as a static database value.
phase9.business_wallet.attribution_body: This section is aggregated by the service layer; the template does not query source data directly.
phase9.business_fgo.title: Internal FGO overview
phase9.business_fgo.heading: Internal FGO overview
phase9.business_convert.title: Submit conversion request
phase9.business_convert.heading: Submit points conversion request
phase9.business_convert.intro: After submission, the request enters governance review. Internal FGO is credited only after approval and execution.
phase9.business_activity.title: Business ledger records
phase9.business_activity.heading: Business wallet activity records
phase9.business_activity.intro: Every internal points and Internal FGO governance change is written to a ledger chain that is not directly editable.
phase9.business_conversions.title: Conversion request records
phase9.business_conversions.heading: Internal FGO conversion requests
phase9.business_conversions.intro: All requests retain submission, approval, rejection, and execution timeline fields.
phase9.business_conversion_detail.title: Conversion request detail
phase9.business_conversion_detail.intro: This page shows the governance status from submission through execution.
phase9.form.points_to_internal_fgo_rate: Internal points to Internal FGO rate
phase9.empty.risk_pending: No requests currently available for review

phase9.message.business_fgo_allocated: Business Internal FGO has been allocated from treasury and written to the ledger.

phase9.message.recovery_recommended: Reserve recovery recommendation has been created.
phase9.message.recovery_triggered: Reserve recovery action has been triggered and written to governance records.
phase9.message.business_conversion_submi: Conversion request has been submitted and is waiting for governance review.

phase9.message.policy_request_created: Governance policy change request has been created and must be reviewed before applying.
phase9.message.policy_request_approved: Policy change request has been approved.
phase9.message.policy_request_rejected: Policy change request has been rejected.
phase9.message.policy_request_applied: The approved governance policy has been applied.
